company.name: Castia
company.shortDescription: Castia is a Latam-based proptech that enables Latam homeowners to relocate to a new property in a quick and easy manner.
company.description: Castia is a Latam based proptech. Acasa enables homeowners in Latam to move to a new home in a fast and simple manner, leveraging their current home equity. Then they sell the old home or else they buy it after 6 months.

productsAndServices.description: A digital platform that enables tenants to pay rent, accumulate points redeemable for home purchase down payments, and build credit history through monthly rent payments.
productsAndServices.name: Castia App

productsAndServices.description: A service that manages and processes rent payments from tenants to landlords through a centralized system, ensuring secure and timely fund transfers.
productsAndServices.name: Rent Payment Management Service

productsAndServices.description: A points-based loyalty program where tenants earn points for rent payments that can be redeemed for gift cards, promotional bonuses, or as funds toward a home down payment.
productsAndServices.name: Castia Bricks Loyalty Program

productsAndServices.description: A service that reports tenants' rent payment history to credit bureaus to help build or improve their credit scores.
productsAndServices.name: Rent Payment Credit Reporting Service

productsAndServices.description: A service that assists tenants in transitioning from renting to homeownership by providing advisory support and access to credit lines for home purchase.
productsAndServices.name: Rent-to-Own Advisory and Financing Service

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $4,700,000, or 12.12% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,076,000 to $33,779,263, a 5.56x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 54 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 55 (+4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Mattis Inmobiliaria, Duppla, nurent.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
